description: This C# source file defines the GrainInterfaceProperties class, which manages a dictionary of interface properties for grains in Orleans, along with related utility classes and interfaces for handling grain interface metadata and attributes.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceProperties
classes.description: Encapsulates an immutable dictionary of interface property key-value pairs, providing a method to generate a detailed string summary.

classes.name: WellKnownGrainInterfaceProperties
classes.description: A static class containing constant string keys for well-known grain interface properties such as version, default grain type, and type name.

classes.name: IGrainInterfacePropertiesProvider
classes.description: Interface for classes that can populate grain interface properties given an interface type and its identifier.

classes.name: IGrainInterfacePropertiesProviderAttribute
classes.description: Interface for attribute classes that provide grain interface properties, allowing attributes to add metadata during runtime.

classes.name: AttributeGrainInterfacePropertiesProvider
classes.description: Implementation of IGrainInterfacePropertiesProvider that gathers property information from custom attributes on interface types.

classes.name: DefaultGrainTypeAttribute
classes.description: An attribute specifying the default grain type for a grain interface, implementing IGrainInterfacePropertiesProviderAttribute.

methods.name: GrainInterfaceProperties
methods.description: Constructor initializing properties with an immutable dictionary.

methods.name: ToDetailedString
methods.description: Builds and returns a detailed string representation of the properties dictionary.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Populates properties based on interface attributes or other metadata.

methods.name: DefaultGrainTypeAttribute
methods.description: Stores a grain type and populates the properties dictionary with this value.
